Deep in the jungles of Brazil lies the ruins of one of automotive history's strangest artifacts- a factory city, built by Henry Ford in the 1920s. It was made to be an American utopia... but instead, it ended in disaster. This is the wild story of how one man foolishly tried to conquer Mother Nature. This is the story of Fordlandia.
